calibrated_reliability.note: In-sample over the settled ledger (the isotonic transform is fit on these same outcomes); held-out 70/30 validation is in recalibration_map.json. p_predicted = raw model prob (kept untouched for the learning loop); p_calibrated = honest prob stamped per pick. Lower ECE/Brier on the calibrated column = the displayed % is truer.

curated.definition: Featured/recommended plays only -- Lock of the Day, Top 25, Whale, Sharp, Consensus (hit), Under Alerts, POD. Excludes the experimental prop feeds, which are tracked to train the model, not bet.

prizepicks.definition: Curated PrizePicks props (Lock of the Day / Top 25), graded at PrizePicks' per-leg break-even of -136 (a 2-pick Power Play pays 3x). Not a sportsbook price, and a single leg cannot be bet alone -- so this is its own line, never part of the curated headline (split out 2026-11-03).

sport_leans.definition: Model leans: the per-sport play on a day a desk has no pick with an edge -- the favourite its model and DraftKings both favour. Logged at the DraftKings price, graded on the final score. Not an edge (expected value is the book's margin) and never part of the curated record.

sport_plays.definition: The play shown for each major sport on each day, graded at the DraftKings price it was logged at. 'desk pick' = a pick with an edge under the desk's rule; 'lean' = the favourite the model and DraftKings both favour on a day the desk has no pick (not an edge). The two are counted separately and are never summed.

board.definition: Every bet on The Board (grades A, B, C), graded on the final score at the DraftKings price the board showed when it first listed the bet: a desk pick (A, B) when its edge first appeared, a lean (C) on game day; an Alpha pick at its locked price. Alpha = the day's locked top-scored picks. Grade C bets are model leans: not an edge, expected to run near the book's margin. None of this is part of the curated record.

legend.A: sportsbook price from a timestamped snapshot at pick time
legend.B: sportsbook price reconstructed from a pre-game snapshot, or stamped without a timestamp
legend.C: no sportsbook price (model's own fair odds, PrizePicks break-even) -- excluded from claims at sportsbook prices

price_corrections.label: price provenance
price_corrections.counts_text: every pick now carries price_provenance (A timestamped book / B reconstructed or untimestamped book / C no sportsbook price); 1 curated total found with no book price, voided
price_corrections.note: Each pick is classed by where its graded price came from. The curated record is now entirely class B (sportsbook prices reconstructed from pre-game snapshots, or stamped without a timestamp); class A -- a timestamped quote at pick time -- starts with picks logged from 2026-11-03. One curated MLB total (9/22 MIL @ PHI over 7.5, written in lower case) had been missed by the earlier pass and was graded at the model's price; no book posted that line, so it is voided.

price_corrections.label: PrizePicks split out + flat 1u stakes
price_corrections.counts_text: 587 PrizePicks props moved to their own line; 249 locks-history picks rescaled from a ~0.06u stake to the flat 1u
price_corrections.note: The curated headline is now graded at real sportsbook prices only. 587 curated PrizePicks props (May 19 - July 9) had been graded at PrizePicks' per-leg break-even (-136, a 2-pick Power Play) -- not a sportsbook line, and a single leg cannot be bet alone -- and they were almost all of the curated profit. They keep their own labelled line (495-92, +271.97u at a flat 1u: 249 of them had been imported from the old locks history at a ~0.06u stake and were rescaled). Its 84% hit rate is far above anything else on the site and comes from that import; treat it as unverified.

price_corrections.label: curated game lines at the model's price
price_corrections.note: Curated MLB moneylines and totals that had no book price stamped were graded at the model's own fair price (8/4 TOR @ HOU home at -106 when the book had -144; LAD @ CHC LAD at +107 vs -131). Each was re-priced at the real pre-game book price (same sources and rules as the placeholder pass), or voided when none is on record.

price_corrections.label: placeholder prices
price_corrections.note: Every settled pick still graded at a -110 that no book posted -- the grader's fallback when a pick had no price, or a board that filled in -110 when its line was missing -- was checked against the prices books actually posted before first pitch (git history: DraftKings, then the Odds API, then Bovada; the exact line for totals, never a snapshot after first pitch). Found: graded at that real price. Not found -- every player prop (1+ hit, home run: no sportsbook prop prices were ever recorded) and the totals no book showed -- voided, wins and losses alike. The 1+ hit props had been overpaid at -110 (real prices run near -250): curated drops ~27u. The home-run props had been underpaid (real prices run +300 and longer) and were not curated: the all-picks line moves from -3,732u to -3,644u.

price_corrections.label: NBA grading
price_corrections.counts_text: 520 settled (190 had been voided as unsettleable, 330 sat pending), 8 re-graded against the right game
price_corrections.record_label: NBA picks (not part of the curated record)
price_corrections.note: NBA picks were dated by the UTC date of tip-off, so every 10 PM ET game carried the next day's date: no box score matched and the pick voided as unsettleable, or, on a back-to-back, it was graded against the next night's game. Team-points, free-throw and full-name team totals had no working grader. Picks are now dated to the US/Eastern game day and graded by matchup; settled picks inside the box-score window were re-checked. Units are at the model's own fair odds (a calibration measure).

MLB moneylines recorded when no book price was loaded had been graded at a placeholder -110. Each was re-priced at the real DraftKings pre-game line (from the snapshot history), or voided when no real line exists.

The same gap on the away side (+100) and the total (8.5), plus Play-of-the-Day moneylines recorded at in-play Bovada prices (10/13 TBR at +940 when DraftKings' pre-game line was -137). Every MLB moneyline is now graded at the DraftKings pre-game line; Play-of-the-Day totals whose 8.5 line DraftKings never posted were voided -- a bet on a line that did not exist has no honest result.

price_corrections.label: totals
price_corrections.note: Top 25 and the Under Alerts read the same placeholder 8.5 total, and some totals were taken from in-play boards. Every settled MLB total was checked against the lines books posted before first pitch: picks on a line no book posted pre-game were voided (they had gone 30-17 -- e.g. UNDER 8.5 when the real total was 6.5), and picks on DraftKings' line are now graded at its real over/under juice instead of a flat -110.

restatement.note: The headline became ALL-TIME on 2026-10-23. 5,946 settled picks that the old tail-cut eviction had destroyed (May-June 2026, the 07-06 erosion and the run-up to 09-03) were rebuilt from git history at each pick's final state, with today's duplicate-wager rule re-applied, and folded back in. They are mostly the raw May-June MLB prop firehose (2,961-2,983, -1,256.9u), so the firehose ROI fell; the curated record changed by the curated picks among them. Before this date the published numbers covered the working window only -- working_ledger_only keeps that basis.

nfl_props_by_model.note: NFL props are judged from 10/23 forward: the simulator's form rule changed, so earlier picks are a different model. They stay on the record as their own line and never feed a family verdict.

note: Unified pick ledger -- records every pick the model surfaces (top_25 board, whales, consensus, unders, sharp action, locks, POD) and settles each against actual outcomes. Per-source W-L feeds back into calibration so the model learns which modules are reliable. THIS is the training signal.

archived_history.note: Settled picks no longer in the working ledger (recovered tail-cut history + lossless evictions). INCLUDED in the all-time headline since 2026-10-23 (see restatement); kept in full at data/ledger_archive.json.
